apps.name: Husk
apps.subtitle: Android app launcher for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Run Android apps on iOS: drop in an APK, tap it, and the Android app opens full-screen on a QEMU guest with hardware-accelerated display and audio. Needs JIT plus a debugger attached at runtime, so it requires a sideloading setup that can provide get-task-allow rather than a plain re-sign.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Welcome to Husk 2.0.
I’ve been working hard over the past few days, and I’m glad to say, Husk 2.0 is out! You’ll enjoy it, a lot.
## What’s new?
- Christmas Decoration
- In-app help feature
- Window manager
- New UI
- Removed downloads tab
## New App Support
- Over 150+ games and apps, now running on Husk.
## Notes:
Thank you all for the continuous support, It’s been a good few months, and I’m just amazed at how big Husk got. Thank you so much, and enjoy Husk 2.0. There is more to come.
